hodge_1a.scope: MERGED graph (both internal ladders + 16 cross edges)
hodge_1a.verdict: BT gate VALIDATED against cycle contamination
hodge_1a.STRUCTURAL_LESSON: The cross-only graph is K(4,4) — COMPLETE BIPARTITE, therefore exactly 0 triangles. HodgeRank's curl is defined on triangles, so a curl read on cross edges ALONE is structurally undefined and returns a confident zero that means nothing. A bipartite graph's cyclic content lives in 4-cycles, which this instrument does not measure. ALWAYS read the merged graph.

s4_order4_B1_stratification.question: is B1's movement owned by the eff/event-window fix (memory) or by the substrate?
s4_order4_B1_stratification.method: model-free: GAP in turns between consecutive same-pair whiffs, from the raw-protocol detector
s4_order4_B1_stratification.VERDICT: IN-WINDOW-CONCENTRATED => the eff fix (MEMORY) owns B1. Short-gap re-clicks fell 5x; long-gap re-clicks did NOT fall (they rose 26%). The substrate's behavioural contribution therefore rests on the injection probe.
s4_order4_B1_stratification.caveat: the boundary is measured in TURNS, not events. The 32-event window was not converted to turn units. The short/long ASYMMETRY does not depend on that; the claim 'the boundary IS the window edge' does.

s_order1_ab_injection.VERDICT: LEARNED BUT INSUFFICIENT (all three pre-committed signatures match). Quantified: the arrival channel now carries 86% of alpha's influence and buys at most 0.049 of probability mass against a policy committed to the whiff at p~0.97. A credit-assignment MAGNITUDE problem.

s_addition1_tdaux_as_bait_lever.scope: 90 sentinel_* battles at step 28M, each of the three rung-2 arms
s_addition1_tdaux_as_bait_lever.VERDICT: FALSIFIED, and in the OPPOSITE direction. B3 rose monotonically with lambda while alpha/beta both improved monotonically. The beliefs got better and the policy got MORE committed to the whiff. TD-aux is NOT the bait lever.
s_addition1_tdaux_as_bait_lever.scope_limit: This says NOTHING about the rung-2 GATES (critic dispersion / explained variance / PIT), which are a separate question and get their own line. A lever can be healthy and still not move this.
s_addition1_tdaux_as_bait_lever.n_caveat: re-clicks are 11/13/17 events; B3 is a median over a handful of loop steps per arm. The MONOTONICITY across three arms and its agreement with the alpha/beta direction is the signal, not any single gap.

s3_order3_pfsp_frame.FRAME_BIAS_VARIANT: DEAD — the sag is CONCENTRATED (heuristic -11pts, aggressive_v2 -8) with four bots flat-or-better; a frame artifact predicts a UNIFORM depression.
s3_order3_pfsp_frame.CAPABILITY_VARIANT: PRIME SUSPECT — PFSP shifts experience toward hardest peers; skills vs under-pool-represented styles atrophy, which predicts exactly this concentration.
s3_order3_pfsp_frame.vs_pool_caveat: win_rate_vs_pool CANNOT adjudicate across runs — each run plays its OWN snapshots, so a lower number is equally consistent with 'I am weaker' and 'my pool is stronger'.
s3_order3_pfsp_frame.OWNER_CORRECTION_BANKED: gen-16 is NOT the first PFSP production run. ai_v8_14_distill3 ran --pfsp-scale 2.5 + --team-pfsp onesided + --stable-opponent-pfsp (the +69 flywheel PoC). 'First PFSP generation' is true of the ai_v9 LINEAGE only; pfsp_hardest_win_rate's absence before gen-16 dates the METRIC, not the feature. The load-bearing contrast: v8_14's PFSP ran over a DIVERSE, ANCHORED pool (stable opponents + teachers) under a distill KL anchor — every pathology mechanism had an opposing force. Gen-16 ran it over a homogeneous fresh-lineage self-pool with none. Any conviction must be written NARROWLY as 'pure PFSP over a homogeneous self-pool', and PFSP's return vehicle is the FLYWHEEL (teachers in pool + uniform floor), not a tuning patch.
